points: The next print will reveal whether the top line is rolling over, and if management guides Q3/Q4 lower it confirms the weakness and justifies the short.

A pending court ruling on the DOL contractor rule could land around the next print; if upheld, RHI’s contract-talent business faces higher compliance costs and margin pressure on the $1.34B service revenue base.

Protiviti’s leadership transition takes effect Jan 1 2027, so clients may delay consulting decisions through Q4 2026, turning a segment that led Q4 2024 growth into a near-term drag and removing a key bull case.

AI-driven platforms are already cutting permanent placements, and if the next print shows contract placements are also weakening, the modest AI tailwind will not stop revenue from sliding and the competitive moat erosion becomes the main story.
UPWK reports on Nov 10 2026, about 69 days out, and a soft peer print would validate the theme’s lean-short breadth of -1.00 and could lead investors to re-rate RHI lower even before its own update.
Macro demand for skilled labor is a high headwind, and if Q3/Q4 2026 macro data worsen, RHI’s placement volumes could fall faster than peers, making the relative underperformance trade work.
